title: Owner decision needed: which rubric dataset after R3?
description:
## Owner decision needed

**Which dataset do we use for the simulated-stakeholder experiment?** Asked after R3, with the screening table. Options: one of EDOS-B / ASAP-SAS / CAP subset / FOMC (or the fallback Gab Hate Corpus), or none (stop the initiative if no candidate passes (a)-(c)).

## Definition of done

Owner's answer recorded as a comment (verbatim), this issue closed, R5 unblocked.

## Cost

$0.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decided: FOMC (run; see R6/R7). FOMC was run. Results: studies/FOMC_RUBRIC_RESULTS.md. The flywheel with simulated explanations (A-c) recovered ~92% of a small 2.8-point gap (S 0.656 -> 0.682 vs labels-only/shuffled ~40-47%); the full published rubric ceiling was only 0.684. The HateCheck/SwDA held-out re-screen failed (studies/rubric_screen/screen_results.json), so no further rubric dataset is run here. Follow-up filed: epic decision-flywheel-evaluations-4a326be6-af63-44fa-b6ec-39e296713109 (streaming SME simulation on Amazon review moderation). Closing.
